terbaru.judul: Cooperation Dynamics with Environmental Feedback: Steady States and Transitions
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a strategy-payoff environmental-feedback model for four canonical games: Prisoner's Dilemma, Snowdrift, Stag-Hunt, and Harmony.

terbaru.judul: Beyond 11/16: dense Kuramoto networks that resist synchrony
terbaru.pelajaran: How densely must a network of identical Kuramoto oscillators be wired before synchrony is its only stable state?

terbaru.judul: Online training of Echo State Networks to predict chaotic dynamical systems
terbaru.pelajaran: Echo State Networks (ESNs) are fundamentally important from the conceptual perspective of AI, because they provide simple and tractable frameworks for understanding temporal information processing, memory, and learning in dynamical systems.

terbaru.judul: Global synchronization in time-varying directed higher-order networks
terbaru.pelajaran: By working in the framework of the Master Stability Function, we show that the linearized dynamics includes two time-dependent Jacobian matrices, both evolving on the timescale of the synchronous solution, together with a generalized Laplacian evolving on a fast switching timescale, resulting from the hypergraph time evolution.

terbaru.judul: Reverse quantum aging: Restoring rhythmicity from quantum aging state
terbaru.pelajaran: Using a self-consistent quantum master equation in the Lindblad form for globally coupled active--inactive quantum Stuart--Landau oscillators, we show that increasing the pumping strength progressively suppresses the aging transition and eventually eliminates it, restoring rhythmicity even when all oscillators are inactive.

terbaru.judul: How Mobile Oscillators Reshape Dynamical Robustness in Complex Networks
terbaru.pelajaran: We show analytically that increased degree heterogeneity in the network enhances the effective coupling strength, and strictly lowers the critical threshold of functional degradation for amplitude death.

terbaru.judul: Joint Trust-Distrust Structure Shapes Belief Propagation and Collective Dynamics
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that the correlation between trust and distrust reshapes the transition between consensus and fragmentation by changing the availability of influential neighbors.

terbaru.judul: Efficient Transport Networks through Edge Pruning by Relative Resistance
terbaru.pelajaran: We find that adaptation by such a local, boundary-condition-free measure of redundancy, set by topology alone, yields sparse, loop-rich, low-dissipation networks.

terbaru.judul: Stochastic resonance in adaptive dynamical networks
terbaru.pelajaran: The role of adaptive coupling in controlling collective noise-induced dynamics is demonstrated on an example of stochastic resonance in an ensemble of coupled overdamped bistable oscillators.

terbaru.judul: If the brain were so simple: Information-based drivers of intelligence and their interaction through an n-body-inspired framework
terbaru.pelajaran: To evaluate the capacity of the external signals to increase information enthalpy in the system, we introduce the information enthalpy potential (IEP) as a defined metric.
